findings.title: Recheck the cache after acquiring the write lock
findings.body: Concurrent callers can all observe a nil cache before this lock, then wait here. Once the first caller loads and stores the assets, each waiting caller still proceeds to load and overwrite the cache because the cached value is never checked again. This causes redundant serialized I/O and, if callers have different configs, can return and leave cached assets from a different config than the one that initialized the cache. Recheck the cache under the lock for non-dev callers before loading.
